prediction: With dynamic-linking enabled, the documented bootstrap route will get past the rustc_driver dylib crate-type rejection. If retained K1–K4 inputs satisfy the dynamic links, llvm-readelf and llvm-nm will expose rustc’s interpreter and its dependency on librustc_driver, plus relocations, TLS and undefined symbols for both ELFs. Budget 10800 seconds for the stage-1 build, with four jobs under taskpolicy.

cargo_configuration.cargo_wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if [ "${1-}" = build ]; then
    compiler=false
    hosted=false
    for arg do
        case "$arg" in
            "$X2_PINNED_RUST/compiler/rustc/Cargo.toml") compiler=true ;;
            "$RUST_TARGET_PATH/x86_64-breenix-hosted.json") hosted=true ;;
        esac
    done
    if "$compiler" && "$hosted"; then
        export RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS-} --cfg=getrandom_backend=\"custom\""
        exec "$X2_STAGE0_CARGO" "$@" -Z unstable-options --config "$X2_CONFIG_ROOT/libc-patch.toml" --lockfile-path "$X2_CONFIG_ROOT/Cargo.lock"
    fi
fi
exec "$X2_STAGE0_CARGO" "$@"
